name: EditorialToolbar

props.description: Listing summary: result count (announced politely) and a note under it.
props.name: summary

related: EditorialFilterPanel — the filters above a listing.
tagline: The row above a collection (gh#1438, gh#1439): an optional `summary` (result count as a polite live region + a short note), a start cluster (an EditorialToggleGroup filter) and an end cluster (order Select, view switch, primary action), optionally over a hairline (`divider`). With a summary it is a listing row that keeps one line; without one a theme stacks it on a phone with `--editorial-toolbar-display: block`. Geometry: `--editorial-toolbar-*`.
usage: DO keep the count text short; a phone theme may hide it (--editorial-toolbar-count-display).
DO keep search in its own row below it.
